profile.headline: Staff / Principal Software Engineer | Platform, Full-Stack & Media Systems | AWS, TypeScript, Go, Python | Production Architecture
profile.summary:
I am a senior and principal-level software engineer with more than a decade of experience building production platforms, full-stack applications, cloud-backed systems, media workflows, and developer tooling.

My background includes engineering and technical leadership work at Fox Corporation, Warner Bros., Activision Blizzard, LADB, Oly.ai, and Clovers.ai. I have owned systems across front-end architecture, backend services, AWS infrastructure, asynchronous processing, media ingestion, CI/CD, production releases, and operational validation.

My current independent work through Justyn Clark Network includes paid client delivery and first-party product engineering. Recent engagements include the Silver Sycamore re-platform and production cutover through Common Thread, feature development for LAC Electric through Cloud 77, and continued development of JustBeatz Music, a full-stack streaming platform I have actively built and maintained for approximately four years.

I also design and publish developer and AI execution systems including SMALL Protocol, Loopexec, Wakeplane, and related local-first infrastructure. My strongest technologies include TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, NestJS, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and event-driven architecture.

I work best in senior individual-contributor and technical-lead roles where I can clarify ambiguous requirements, design practical systems, remain hands-on through implementation, and take responsibility for production outcomes.

I publish independent engineering work under the Justyn Clark name through Justyn Clark Network.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Independent Consultant
positions.description:
Lead current product engineering and selective client delivery through an independent software and media engineering studio.
 
JustBeatz Music - Architect, build, and actively maintain a full-stack music streaming platform spanning listener experiences, backend services, administrative tooling, catalog and metadata management, media ingestion, PostgreSQL, object storage, and ongoing production operations.
 
Silver Sycamore / Common Thread - Led website migration, re-platforming, production cutover, and launch validation, protecting business-critical inquiry, booking, analytics, advertising attribution, integrations, and customer journeys.
 
LAC Electric / Cloud 77 - Delivered paid production feature development within an existing client application and deployment environment.
 
Developer Infrastructure - Design and release systems including SMALL Protocol, Wakeplane, Loopexec, and related local-first execution tooling using Go, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
 
Across client and first-party work, I produce architecture plans, implementation handoffs, validation gates, operational documentation, and stakeholder-facing delivery records.
 
Earlier independent work, 2008-2016: Delivered websites, content systems, digital media experiences, and technical production work for small-business, entertainment, and creative clients, progressing from web production and front-end implementation into application engineering, integrations, and broader system ownership.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Systems Engineering · Web Application Development · Cloud Applications · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Product Development · User Experience (UX) · Developer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a full-stack SaaS web application/platform designed for video media upload, processing workflow jobs and mediatranscoding. Features included admin dashboard, subscriptions and payments, analytics, email marketing, notifications,onboarding, feature flags, cache and metrics.	

• Built a custom AWS S3 bucket multipart file uploader optimized to handle large video files (2-5 GB), providing real-timeprogress updates and resumable uploads in case of connection failures.	

• Designed a Workflow system allowing admin users to create and manage JSON templates with dynamic fields and real-timevalidation to submit jobs that are sent through SQS queue messaging system with notifications and DCP asset delivery.

• Wrote and integrated backend services to validate and store user inputs, ensuring the consistency and integrity of the datastored in PostgreSQL.

• Lead the entire project gathering requirements, documenting process, establishing meetings and communication channels.

projects.title: SMALL Protocol
projects.description:
SMALL is a state protocol designed to make AI systems legible, deterministic, and safe to operate at scale.

Modern AI-assisted workflows often fail in the same way: intent is implicit, state is ephemeral, and execution decisions disappear once a session ends. This makes systems difficult to audit, resume, or trust.

SMALL does not add intelligence or features. It introduces structure.

By externalizing intent, constraints, progress, and handoff into explicit, machine-readable artifacts, SMALL makes execution inspectable in the same way modern infrastructure and data systems are.

SMALL is intentionally minimal by design. Its goal is not convenience, but correctness
